hotels.title: Secluded Ha Long Bay Bliss with Rooftop Bar, Infinity Pool, Spa, Onsen & Zipline
hotels.description: Heed the call of Ha Long Bay's famed emerald waters with a stay at this secluded paradise on the sands of Quan Lan Island. Surrounded by unspoilt tropical greenery and calm waters, this sprawling resort invites you to slow down - lounge by an expansive lagoon pool, unwind with treatments at Angsana Spa and Onsen or listen to the rhythmic hush of the tide along the pristine beach. Four exquisite restaurants and bars serve up satiating experiences, from authentic Vietnamese at Market Place to crafted cocktails with a view at The Sky Bar at the resort's peak. When adventure calls, get your thrills on Vietnam's first zipline, practice your putt on the mini golf course, take a kayak out or add a touch of elegance with a luxury cruise through the UNESCO-recognised Ha Long Bay.

hotels.title: Vietnam Island Luxury Moments from Ha Long Bay with Daily Breakfast, Dinner & Free-Flow Cocktail Hour
hotels.description: Ha Long Bay's UNESCO-listed seascape is the backdrop - and Angsana Quan Lan puts you right in the heart of it, without the crowds. Sitting on the unspoilt shores of Quan Lan Island, this is the ultimate gateway to one of Southeast Asia's most spectacular natural wonders, complete with a Sky Pool, lagoon pool, and Vietnam’s first and only coastal zipline. When hunger strikes, Market Place serves all-day Vietnamese dining, while Breeze handles casual poolside bites and local street food. For sundowners, The Sky Bar earns its name - panoramic ocean views, handcrafted cocktails, and Asian tapas at Quan Lan's highest vantage point. Angsana Spa rounds out the indulgence with treatments using native flowers and fruits, plus a Japanese-inspired Onsen with indoor and outdoor pools. For those who want more action, the resort more than delivers. Ride Vietnam's only resort-integrated coastal zipline straight to Son Hao Beach, tackle the 18-hole mini-golf course, or take to the water with kayaking, paddleboarding and more. Come evening, gather for garden movie screenings or stargaze with the resort's telescopes.
